- Keep latency targets stable during the canary phase
- Ensure your SREs have a dry-run before the customer-facing migration

1) 2‑hour warroom kickoff (internal + NovaPay ops) — Thu 2028-09-14 09:00–11:00 PT
2) Canary window 1 (10% traffic) — Mon 2028-09-30 02:00–06:00 PT
3) Canary window 2 (40% traffic) — Wed 2028-10-04 02:00–08:00 PT (only if C1 metrics OK)
